Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Add DashKit CLI tool for agent distribution

Implement a TypeScript CLI tool that installs and manages DashKit agent
definitions in user projects. The tool provides init, update, status, and
version commands with comprehensive error handling.

Features:
- CLI commands: init \(install\), update \(upgrade\), status, version
- Automatic git repository detection with --here flag override
- Version tracking via dashkit.config.js
- Update detection using semantic versioning
- Agent templates bundled in package

Architecture:
- TypeScript with ES modules \(Node 18+\)
- Vitest test framework \(native ESM support\)
- Commander.js for CLI parsing
- Monolithic package with templates included
- Published to GitHub Packages as @sfwd-dashapps/dashkit

Testing:
- 59 tests total \(55 passing, 4 skipped\)
- Unit tests for utilities \(git, config, version, files, errors\)
- Integration tests for all commands
- TDD approach: tests written before implementation

Documentation:
- Main project README with installation and usage
- CLI-specific README with command reference
- Updated CLAUDE.md with CLI development guidance

Technical Decisions:
- Switched from Jest to Vitest for better ESM/import.meta support
- Monolithic package \(templates bundled\) over registry-based approach
- JavaScript config files for user-editability
- Cache-busting imports for test reliability

Co-Authored-By: Claude \(us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0\) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
